digest.component_or_area: code review impact model (v3 → v4 redesign)
propositions: Code-review gate cannot block test-sufficiency findings because code-v3 impact model discards verifier's user-reach judgments (prod_impact and trigger_likelihood) for maintenance-lane findings.

Contract-contradicting-assertion antipattern is missing: a test forbidding a state that the same diff's contract declares allowed will not be flagged by Pass-1 since it matches no existing antipattern.

Maintenance-lane severity calculation under v3 is dampened by absent-churn (×0.5 when churn90 missing on 80% of corpus) and does not consume prod_impact, capping dominant binary at ~0.30 vs tests@0.95 advisory threshold.

v4 redesign must consume prod_impact/trigger_likelihood as guarded-path user-reach (not test-only) for coverage/contract findings, implement lane-scoped trigger maps, restrict reversibility floor to consequence lanes, and route tests to blocking@0.54.

Fire case (commit 8eadb4fbc5) shipped contract allowing stale>0 with test asserting stale=0 (contradiction) and was not blocked because the antipattern and prod-impact-keyed maint severity both were absent.

Replay over 1243 changes shows v3 blocks 42 (3.4%) while v4+tests@0.54 blocks 99 (8.0%) with zero demotions of currently-blocking findings, validated against hand-adjudicated corpus (70 prod=med/high tests findings uniformly load-bearing).
